    """Return True if all brackets in s are balanced and strings are closed.

    Brackets inside double-quoted strings are ignored. Inside a string, a
    backslash makes the next character ordinary, so a quoted quote does not
    end the string. An unclosed string makes the result False.
    """
    pairs = {')': '(', ']': '[', '}': '{'}
    stack = []

                # character, the string never closes.

            if ch == '"':

            i += 1

        elif ch in '([{':
            stack.append(ch)
        elif ch in ')]}':
            if not stack or stack[-1] != pairs[ch]:
                return False
            stack.pop()

        i += 1

    return not in_string and not stack
